title: Trade Trip Rates for Missed Warranty Appointments — Calloway Limited Home Warranty
content:
Trade trip multiplier of the missed-appointment charge, Calloway Limited Home Warranty: 1.50 where a licensed trade was sent, 1.25 where a specialty finish installer was sent, 1.00 otherwise, applied to the program's missed-appointment fee.

The trade trip multiplier follows the defect category of the missed appointment's claim item, as the item was filed:

| Defect category of the claim item | Trade sent | Trade trip multiplier |
|---|---|---|
| plumbing, electrical or hvac | a licensed trade | 1.50 |
| flooring, tile, or cabinets and countertops | a specialty finish installer | 1.25 |
| any other category | — | 1.00 (no adjustment) |

**Points of reading.**
- The category is that of the claim item whose appointment was missed, not of any other item on the coverage.
- Drywall, paint, trim carpentry, roofing and every category not named in the first two rows take 1.00.
- Hypothetical illustration: a missed appointment on a tile item takes 1.25; one on an electrical item takes 1.50.
